newsitem.title: USA: HealthSouth to redeem convertible debentures.
newsitem.headline: HealthSouth to redeem convertible debentures.

text.p: BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Feb 24 Reuter) - HealthSouth Corp said Monday it called for redemption on April 1, 1997, of all of its outstanding five percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2001 at a redemption price of 102.86 percent of the principal amount of the debentures, plus accrued interest to the redemption date.

The company said the debentures are currently convertible into HealthSouth common stock at a price of $18.8125 per share, which would result in a conversion rate of 53.156 shares of HealthSouth common stock per $1,000 in principal amount of debentures.

HealthSouth also said it declared a two-for-one stock split payable in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend to holders of record on March 13, subject to the approval by stockholders of an amendment to increase the company's shares to 500 million shares.

The amendment will be voted on at a special stockholder meeting on March 12. If the amendment were approved and the stock split effected, the conversion price of the debentures would be adjusted accordingly, the company said.
